tool.name: pmotools extract_info
tool.description: List and count specimens, samples, targets, and metadata from a PMO
tool.command: pmotools-python ${info_type.info_command} --file '$input_pmo' #if str($info_type.info_command) == "list_bioinformatics_run_names": --output '$output' #else: --output '$output' --delim '$info_type.delim' #end if --overwrite #if str($info_type.info_command) == "count_specimen_meta": --meta_fields '$info_type.meta_fields' #elif str($info_type.info_command) == "count_targets_per_library_sample": --read_count_minimum '$info_type.read_count_minimum' #elif str($info_type.info_command) == "count_library_samples_per_target": --read_count_minimum '$info_type.read_count_minimum' #end if

param.name: info_command
param.label: Information to extract
param.option: List library sample names per specimen

param.label: Minimum read count
param.help: Minimum read count (inclusive) to be counted as covered by sample

param.label: Minimum read count
param.help: Minimum read count (inclusive) to be counted as covered by sample

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Extract Info from PMO**
Extracts basic information and summary statistics from a PMO file:
- **List library sample names per specimen**: Tabulate which library samples belong to each specimen - **List specimen metadata fields**: Show the metadata field names available in the specimen_info section - **List bioinformatics run names**: List all bioinformatics run names in the PMO - **Count specimen metadata values**: Count unique values of selected metadata fields (e.g. country, date) - **Count targets per library sample**: Count the number of targets detected per library sample - **Count library samples per target**: Count the number of library samples in which each target was detected
